Agent Name: GameTheory_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: They mis-modeled the distribution constraint and enumerated invalid box counts (e.g., listing triples that don’t sum to 30) and then proposed the flawed strategy of guessing (2, 11, 17), claiming it guarantees winning all 30 coins. This misinterprets the game mechanics: guesses are fixed per box before reveal, overestimates yield zero for that box, and the “6 more than another box” relation need not be between the two largest ordered boxes. These errors led directly to the incorrect conclusion of a $30,000 guaranteed minimum instead of the correct $16,000.
